Shaped iteration 0095 as one independent review of #481's writing-method extension.
[Task graph](tasks.json): reviewer, default/high, 120 minutes and 65 turns, no dependencies; #481 report explicitly exported.
The [author report](reports/481.json) records accepted preparation work, not owner method acceptance.
The [specification overview](../benchmark/writing/README.md) explicitly remains unreviewed and identifies four writing contracts.
Its [verification record](../benchmark/writing/verification.json) reports 35 rejecting synthetic controls and zero native/agent executions.
That makes independent review the next concrete step under the [role sequence](../docs/perpetua/roles.md).
The task pins baseline and candidate commits, requires candidate tree resolution, and checks original evidence and output hashes.
It requests separate Standards/Spec assessments, two additional counterexamples and actionable findings without changing reviewed files.
Verification is `python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py`; passing establishes bounded design consistency only.
Read the graph back and checked its structure, role, limits, dependencies and required sections; no shell verification was available.
[Working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) preserves deferred threads and the review-dependent next steps.
No LabVIEW execution, benchmark readiness, method acceptance or product implementation is claimed.

## What next
Execute the pinned review, then read its findings and counterexample evidence before ordering corrections or another preparation task. Resume from the six saved writing files; avoid repeating POC reverse engineering, global gap inventories or the author's extension work.
